title: Classic Middle Eastern Shakshuka
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and diced
1 can (28 oz) whole peeled tomatoes, crushed by hand
2 tsp sweet paprika, 1.5 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp chili flakes or cayenne
Fresh cilantro and parsley, chopped, plus crusty bread for dipping
instructions: Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Sauté diced onion and red bell pepper for 6–8 minutes until soft.
Add minced garlic, paprika, cumin, and chili flakes; stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes with their juices, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.

Make 6 small wells in the tomato sauce and crack an egg into each well. Sprinkle with crumbled feta, cover the pan, and cook on medium-low for 5–7 minutes until whites are set and yolks are runny. Garnish with fresh herbs.
